summary: Iteration-10 verifies the two iteration-9 fixes: (1) CompanyProfile case-study metrics chip render and (2) cleanup of TEST/Copy/Starter plans. All three target company profiles (/companies/nexora-digital, /companies/datapulse-analytics, /companies/bakı-software-studio) now load WITHOUT the 'Objects are not valid as a React child' runtime error. Case-study section renders correctly with chip pills (e.g. 'Vaxt: 12 həftə', 'Büdcə: 65k AZN', 'Komanda: 8 nəfər'). /api/plans returns exactly 4 entries [free,pro,premium,enterprise] and /pricing renders 4 plan cards with no TEST/Copy/Starter remnants. Public /api/companies/nexora-digital response now includes case_studies with full {title, challenge, approach, results, metrics, image_url}. Backend regression: 56/56 PASSED (45 iteration-7 + 11 iteration-9). Demo-login provider → /api/me/case-studies smoke returns 1 case study for Nexora Digital with metrics as list of {k,v} objects. NOTE: One environment-level hiccup — the dev frontend bundle was stale on first visit (hot-reload missed the CompanyProfile.jsx edit); a supervisor restart of frontend cleared it and the fix took effect. Recommend main agent be aware HMR may not always pick up edits inside conditional render trees.

rca of the issue: Original crash: seed_data.CASE_STUDY_TPL.metrics_kv is a list[{k,v}] and was returned verbatim from /api/public/companies/{id}/case-studies; CompanyProfile.jsx tried to render it as a React child. Fix verified at lines 597–607: Array.isArray branch renders chips, string fallback preserved. Initial verification still showed the crash because the webpack dev-server HMR had not detected the edit (bundle missing 'Array.isArray(item.metrics)' string). After `supervisorctl restart frontend` the bundle rebuilt (now contains the new code, bundle size 12,364,765 bytes) and all three company pages render correctly with no runtime error.
